chunks: (10) Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated to me, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik al-Fazari narrated to me, saying: Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Wahb narrated to me, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha' narrated to me, from Abbas ibn Abdullah, from Dawud ibn Sarhan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said:
The year in which the Cry occurs, before it is the Sign in the month of Rajab. I asked: What is it? He said: A face will appear on the moon, and a protruding hand.

key_terms.الآيَةُ: The Sign, a miraculous occurrence preceding major events
key_terms.الصَّيْحَةُ: The Cry (from Heaven), a major eschatological event
key_terms.رَجَبٌ: The seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar
key_terms.قَبْلَهُ: Before it (referring to the year of the Cry)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific signs in Rajab that precede the Heavenly Cry according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the 'face' (Wajh) and 'hand' (Yad) emerging in the moon during Rajab are identified as the final celestial signs preceding the Heavenly Cry (As-Sayhah) that will announce the beginning of the Great Resurrection. This event is situated within the eschatological timeline of the Twelfth Imam's reappearance, serving as a definitive divine marker for the end of the current age.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (10) Muhammad bin Hammam narrated from Ja’far bin Muhammad bin Malik al-Fazari from Musa bin Ja’far bin Wahab from al-Hasan bin Ali al-Washsha’ from Abbas bin Abdullah from Dawood bin Sarhan that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said:
“Before the year of the cry (from the Heaven), there will be a sign in the month of Rajab.” He was asked: “What is it?” He said: “A face will appear on the moon and a protruding hand.”
